title: Dilworth Multiplicity Bounds for the Signless Laplacian and Distance Signless Laplacian of C-Graphs and Threshold Graphs
description: The second manuscript version extends the repaired multiplicity bound to all connected C-graphs. It identifies the unique smallest counterexample to the Mandal–Manna conjecture and reports exact computations on all 404 connected cographs of orders two through eight.
